decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a relatively low-cost line extension with moderate remaining uncertainty, so the option is cheap to keep open.
CeraFrame Liquid has shown enough commitment through its own pages and targets a growing seamless-bathroom trend, making the option likely worth maintaining.

As a newer pump-drain shower channel with unresolved demand and some category risk from the earlier dropped pump product, it is kept for now but has a higher chance of being abandoned if results are weak.
